# PR #2836: Patch: set pieces: one capped, skippable board-wide beat per action, and a Big moments setting

Closes #2785

## What changed

The board now has one way to hold the game: the **set piece**. #2722's Mythic takeover hold used to live on `EntryEntrance.holdMs`; it is now the first set piece, `AnimationEntry.setPiece = { key, holdMs }`, and plays exactly as before. Any other card or system can claim a set piece through the queue's `setPieceOf` option, which is asked before the takeover. Ruling R2785000 amends R200, R2722001 and R2126000.

**The hold**
- `setPieceHoldMs` and `setPieceEntries` in `game/animations.ts` set its length:
  - it scales with the effects speed (`scaleForSpeed`, R201);
  - it is never below `MIN_ENTRY_MS`;
  - it is never above `SET_PIECE_HOLD_CAP_MS` (3 s of real time).
- The burst budget never squeezes it: `pinned` covers `entry.setPiece`.
- An action gets at most `SET_PIECES_PER_ACTION` (1). A second claim in the same action plays as a plain entry.
- `data-animating` stays on through the hold, so `cy.settled()` waits for it.

**Skip**
- `AnimationQueue.skip()` ends the held entry at once and starts the next one. It does nothing on a plain entry.
- `Game.tsx` triggers it from a capture-phase click on the board or from Space. The skip does nothing else:
  - the click reaches no control;
  - the keyup of the skipping Space is swallowed, so a focused button isn't pressed;
  - Space in a text field belongs to the field.
- On a skip, `FxLayer` calls a new `director.cut()`.
- A "Tap to skip" hint fades in after `SET_PIECE_SKIP_HINT_MS`.
- The shortcuts test now counts `game/Game.tsx: 2` board key handlers.

**Big moments**
- `FxSettings.bigMoments` is `full`, `short` or `off`. `short` caps the hold at `SET_PIECE_SHORT_HOLD_MS`; `off` gives no hold.
- It is stored in `jackioh.fx.v1` and syncs with the account's `fx` group. An unknown stored value reads as `full`.
- The settings panel's Visuals section has a new row for it.

**Where it plays**
- No hold under reduced motion, with the effects off, or on a `silent` board (the Duos teammate's).
- Live games, both hotseat seats, replays and watching all play it.

**This run (after main's #2830 merge)**
- Resolved the conflict in `spec/10-engine-guide.md` §10.10 by keeping both sentences: this branch's R2785000 sentence, then main's new R2784000 sentence.
- #2830 added the `/dev/fx` gallery the issue asked for (earlier runs had found none), so I added the fixture set piece to it:
  - `Game` gained a `setPieceOf?: SetPieceClaimer` prop, passed to the queue through a ref (the queue is built once);
  - `fx/motifs/gallery.ts` gained `GALLERY_SET_PIECE`, `galleryPlayId` and `gallerySetPiece`;
  - the gallery gained a "Play as a set piece" button, which plays the picked card with its `cardPlayed` entry holding for `SET_PIECE_HOLD_MS`;
  - an R2785000 test in `routes/dev/fx.test.tsx` checks the hold, the hint and the click skip, and that a plain play holds nothing;
  - R2785000, its pending paragraph and `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md` now mention the gallery.

## How it was tested

All run on the merged tree after `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`. Everything passed:

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game src/fx src/settings src/shortcuts src/i18n src/routes src/motion.test.ts src/surfaces.test.ts src/palette.test.ts src/wording.test.ts src/typescale.test.ts` | 207 files, 3964 tests passed |
| The harness's `pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude …` | 324 files, 6067 tests passed |
| `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` | passed |
| `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` | passed |
| `cargo jackioh spec check` | `1624 rulings, 3850 proofs … ok` |
| `patches check`, `catalog check`, `cargo fmt --check` | passed |
| `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` | `classify: App` |
| `E2E_COMPONENT_PORT=5281 pnpm test:component --spec cypress/component/fx-layer.cy.tsx` | 5/5, both R2785000 skip specs included |
| `cypress/e2e/01-hotseat-full-game.cy.ts` on a `build:e2e` client | 1/1 |

The smoke's replay-hash step looks for `./target/release/jackioh`, but cargo builds into `$CARGO_TARGET_DIR` here. I symlinked it for the run and removed the link afterwards. No Rust code changed, so I did not run clippy or `cargo test`.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Reduced motion has no still frame.** The queue's reduced-motion drain is synchronous, so a still would hold nothing; `SET_PIECE_STILL_MS` doesn't exist. A Mythic's own still card (R2722001) is unchanged.
- **A skip uses `director.cut()`, not `clear()`.** `cut()` lands what the set piece still had to land on the board and keeps the stand-ins and hidden cards. `clear()`, as a drain does, would pop a played card back into the hand mid-burst. I also rejected fast-forwarding the cues, which the director can't do.
- **The numbers are the planner's: please tune them.** Hold 2000 ms, cap 3000 ms, short 600 ms, hint 500 ms.
- **The cap shortens the takeover at 0.25× speed:** 3 s instead of 4 s. It is unchanged at every other speed.
- **The gallery's fixture claims the play's `cardPlayed` entry**, as the takeover does. I rejected claiming the motif's damage entry: a motif's beats are fractions of the entry's length, so its landing would fall inside the hold, out of step with the board's delayed motion.
- **Deferred to #2782's first real set piece:** the sound bed and the music duck. Neither is in the acceptance list.
- **Clocks:** the engine and server clocks are unchanged. The ruling notes that a hold eats the watching seat's real time, bounded by the cap.

## Worth a second look

- `Game.tsx`'s skip listeners stay attached for the board's whole life, but they only act while `runner.skip()` returns true, which is only during a hold. That is how the keyup after a skip is still caught.
- The gallery test holds and skips first, then lets the board catch up before the plain play. With real timers, a play made while an earlier burst is still running only queues behind it.
